Being twelve and smaller than your friends isn't something you fix fast, and it's not really about them anyway — it's about what your own training looks like over the next few years. Growth happens on its own schedule, but strength is something you can build now with good habits: learn solid technique on the basics, be consistent, eat enough, sleep enough. That's really the whole game at your age.

If you want, tell me what you've got access to — gym, home equipment, just bodyweight — and I'll help put something together for you to build off of.
